Name: Progressive Seed Maker
Author: WoosterUK
Description:
[b][size=5]Detailed description[/size][/b]
This mod puts the Seed Maker system into three tiers.
[list]
[*]The Copper Seed Maker, available to all Farmers of Level 1 and above, will take your crops and spit out one to three units of Mixed Seed / Mixed Flower Seed as appropriate.
[*]The Iron Seed Maker, available from Level 6 and constructed from the remnants of your Copper Seed Maker plus one Iron Bar, will adopt the Copper Seed Maker's behaviour half the time and the regular Seed Maker's behaviour the other half.
[*]The regular Seed Maker is available at the usual level in Farming, is constructed from an Iron Seed Maker plus a Gold Bar, and behaves as normal.
[/list][line][b][size=5]Development goals[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]"Story mode", with seed maker recipes dropping as a result of friendships, quests and other varied challenges.

[/list][line][url=https://gitlab.com/stardew_valley/progressive_seed_maker]Source code[/url]. Please use the GitLab page to report bugs.
